claims.statement: Dan Daly knocked Tom Allen out in one round, rules barred, in a street fight outside Daly's saloon on Seventh street.
claims.excerpt: was knocked out in one round (rules barred) by Dan Daly

claims.statement: Tom Allen claimed one of three men who had been calling him names was in Dan Daly's saloon.

places: Seventh street between Market and Chestnut streets

claims.statement: Tom Allen was said to have accused Dan Daly of doing things to hurt his business.
